facts: The entire career is in regulated financial services: clean-energy lending, embedded finance and institutional crypto banking.

At both Mosaic and Anchorage Digital, Nathan has been responsible for OFAC monitoring of onboarded customers. He works directly with compliance and sanctions teams and has built and improved automation infrastructure and vendor integrations for OFAC screening.

At Anchorage Digital, Nathan's Client Onboarding & Risk Platform scope also covers transaction monitoring, SAR monitoring and reporting, and initial and ongoing sanctions, PEP and negative-news screening. He owns the roadmap for these areas, plans, builds and prioritizes vendor integrations, and is an admin for the internal case-management tooling.

roles.title: Senior Product Manager, Client Onboarding & Risk Platform
roles.note: Moved from Client Insights & Automation to take over Client Onboarding & Risk when the team needed a PM to lead it. Onboarding serves institutional clients worldwide across Anchorage’s US, Singapore and Cayman Islands entities.

cards.headline: Client onboarding throughput, ~265 → 1,000+ a quarter, in a year
cards.headlineSource: condensed from detail by Claude — Nathan to review
cards.detail: Quadrupled throughput of a complex, high-stakes client onboarding workflow (~265 → 1,000+ completed per quarter) within a year of taking over the squad.

cards.headline: Average handle time, cut by automation while volume quadrupled
cards.headlineSource: condensed from detail by Claude — Nathan to review
cards.detail: Drove onboarding automation (partner verification reliance, automated document collection, reusable questionnaires), bringing average handle time down to 4.5 days while quarterly volume quadrupled.

cards.headline: Onboarded 380+ institutional clients that have so far driven $18M+ in revenue
cards.detail: Lead the product lifecycle and PDE team for the onboarding of 380+ institutional clients to a regulated financial institution, resulting in an additional $18M+ in revenue.

cards.headline: New product lines approved same day, without a multi-day re-application
cards.detail: Shipped progressive onboarding, letting existing clients add a product line by reusing what they've already provided. A multi-day application became same-day approval with no new questions, and clients using more than one product line grew ~30% after launch.

cards.headline: (7 eng, 1 design), aligned with 5 compliance and ops teams
cards.detail: Lead an 8-person squad (7 engineers, 1 designer), aligning priorities across compliance, sanctions, financial intelligence, due-diligence operations and periodic client review.

cards.headline: Teammates querying a Claude knowledge system I built
cards.headlineSource: condensed from detail by Claude — Nathan to review
cards.detail: Built Claude-based team tools: a knowledge system that auto-files meeting notes (escalating uncertain cases for review) and makes PRDs and discovery docs queryable for 15–20 teammates.

cards.headline: adopted an interactive roadmap artifact I built with Claude Code.
cards.detail: Built a live, clickable roadmap with embedded prototypes and easy cross team syncing for the latest true snapshot. It was adopted by 3 product squads in place of slide decks.

cards.headline: Kept AML case operations scaling through a 139.9% volume rise
cards.detail: Supported compliance operations through a 139.9% rise in comparable alert and case volume versus the same-length period before I joined. All of it ran through the case-management system I administer, while I shipped workflow optimizations and Slack automations to ensure the team could continue to scale volume.

cards.headline: New product, design and eng hires trained on org-wide standards
cards.headlineSource: condensed from detail by Claude — Nathan to review
cards.detail: Co-developed org-wide product development standards (PRD templates, lifecycle expectations, training materials) and ran onboarding training for 62 new product, design and engineering hires.

cards.headline: Re-architecting the core onboarding platform, live ops untouched
cards.headlineSource: condensed from detail by Claude — Nathan to review
cards.detail: Product support and championship of a re-architecture of the core onboarding platform (data-model redesign, account migration, legacy retirement) with no disruption to live operations.

cards.headline: Major partnerships, from a new payment-collection product

cards.detail: Launched a payment-collection product with two new partners, doubling major partnerships in its B2B2B model.

siteBuild.intro: This website is entirely the result of me working via Claude. Layout, user experience, features, and content all come from me. The underlying code and infrastructure is guided and executed by Claude. I built this because I can and because I had fun doing it.
stack: Plain HTML and CSS, generated from one structured content file and served by Cloudflare. Minimal JavaScript; every page reads without it.
Light and dark themes; the site follows your system setting until you pick one.
Visits are counted without cookies or third-party trackers, and IP addresses are never stored.

jobFit.lede: Paste a job description. You get a read on how my experience fits, requirement by requirement, with the evidence quoted from my CV and the gaps stated plainly.
jobFit.dataNote: The job description you paste is sent to Anthropic's Claude to produce the read, and saved on this site so I can see which roles were checked. Please don't paste anything confidential. No cookies are set, and your IP address isn't stored.
jobFit.method: Claude reads the posting against my CV with instructions to cite evidence for every match and to say so when the CV is silent. Code then checks every citation against the CV and downgrades any match it can't verify. The quotes you see are my CV's own words.
